$comment: Two-tier CWV budget — see docs/cwv-budget.md for the full rationale.
Ceilings follow one rule: ceiling = max(target, measured_median * ~1.2).
So a metric already inside target (CLS, TBT everywhere) has ceiling == target and must stay good;
a metric short of target (LCP everywhere) gets ~20% headroom over today's median for Lighthouse noise.
Baselines: Lighthouse mobile, median of 3, vs https://market.bushpop.xyz on 2026-07-10.
Re-baseline deliberately when a page's content genuinely changes — never to turn a red run green.
